segments.name: Secured debt investments
segments.description: Originates and holds secured debt loans to U.S. middle market companies, supported by financial sponsors.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reporting segment with an investment objective to generate current income and, to a lesser extent, capital appreciation primarily through assembling a portfolio of secured debt investments in U.S. middle market companies.

revenueModel.text: Private U.S. middle market borrowers, often controlled by private equity firms, pay interest on secured loans the company originates.
revenueModel.evidence: The Middle Market Senior Loans are generally made to private U.S. middle market companies that are, in many cases, controlled by private equity firms.
